payload.summary: The licensing policy that is actually in force in Norwich today, approved by full council in December 2021 and running to 79 pages. It sets out how the council decides applications to sell alcohol, put on regulated entertainment or serve hot food between 11pm and 5am, what conditions may be attached to a licence, and how licences are reviewed and enforced, with pools of model conditions for each of the four licensing objectives. It stays in force until a revised policy is adopted. The council publishes it as a bare PDF with no page of its own on the website.
